notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.dunelm.com/robots.txt) has no disallow for generic user-agents or Claude/anthropic bots on /category/ paths, so tier (a) HTTP fetch was permitted. Tier (a) (curl_cffi + bs4) was used to pull /sitemap.xml -> /sitemap/category-sitemap.xml (653 category URLs) and the homepage for the top-level nav links. However Dunelm's category pages are client-rendered (React SPA) and do not include product counts or the mega-menu tree in the raw server HTML, so tier (b) Playwright (headless Chromium, sync API) was used to render each candidate category page, read the hydrated Redux state embedded in the DOM (nav mega-menu JSON with full label/URL tree) and the rendered page text for product counts. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. TREE: union of (1) the site's mega-menu nav JSON extracted from the hydrated page state (top nav: New, Offers, Garden & Travel, Furniture & Beds, Bedding, Home Decor, Curtains, Blinds, Lighting, Rugs, Kitchen & Utility, Bath, Decorating & DIY, Storage, Kids) and (2) /sitemap/category-sitemap.xml (653 clean category URLs). Only clean canonical URLs (no query string) that are confirmed either in the mega-menu or as a genuine distinct product-type page were kept; colour/shape/size/material facet landing pages (e.g. rugs/blue-rugs, rugs/round-rugs, bedding/100-cotton-bedding), 'All X' / Shop-All aggregator pages where real subcategories exist, brand-collection pages (Dorma, Disney, etc.), and fabric-sample/swatch pages were excluded as non-taxonomy landing pages. FURNITURE BOUNDARY: any node whose URL lives under /home-and-furniture/furniture/... (storage-furniture, storage-benches-and-ottomans, hallway-furniture-and-storage, modular-storage-furniture, bathroom-furniture-and-storage, wardrobes, chest-of-drawers, bookcases, display-cabinets, storage-bed-frames, etc.) was treated as owned by Furniture.xlsx per the site's own explicit Furniture-path categorization and excluded from Storage here, per storage.md rule 21/27 ('if the website explicitly places the product inside a Furniture category, prefer Furniture'). QTY: extracted from the rendered category page's own visible product-count text ('<label> / NNN results', the pagination-total equivalent of storage.md rule 36.2), read via Playwright after the page hydrated (page.inner_text('body')); each qty is the exact number shown, no estimation. H1/canonical were checked against the intended node on every leaf per the brief's bad-slug warning. EXCLUDED (bad slug / silently serves a different node's content, confirmed by duplicate qty + wrong H1): bedding/bed-linen (served Bed Sheets, 243), bedding/bedding-sets (served Duvet Covers, 1091), made-to-measure/cushion-covers (served the generic 'All Cushions' listing, 282), kids/kids-bed-sheets (served Kids Bedding, 554), christmas/christmas-decorations/christmas-tree-skirts (redirected to the generic Christmas Shop landing page, no product count). EXCLUDED (seasonal collection, not a distinct product type): bedding/winter-bedding, bedding/summer-bedding, bedding/brushed-cotton-bedding, bedding/100-cotton-bedding. EXCLUDED (hardware/non-fabric, or mixed-material ambiguous blind pages): curtain poles/tracks/rings/rings-and-fixtures, blind-accessories, shutters, venetian-blinds, vertical-blinds, cordless-blinds, bathroom-blinds, door-blinds, no-drill-blinds, perfect-fit-blinds. EXCLUDED (not textile/storage primary product type): hot-water-bottles, bean-bags, draught-excluders, fabric-and-haberdashery craft/sewing/yarn/knitting/foam pages, fabric-samples/swatch pages, upholstery-fabric-swatch-samples. EXCLUDED (general waste bin, not an organizational storage product): cleaning-and-laundry/bins, bathroom/bathroom-accessories/bathroom-bins. EXCLUDED (food-storage siblings that are drinkware/serveware, not storage): food-storage/water-bottles-and-flasks, food-storage/fruit-bowls-and-salad-bowls. EXCLUDED (garage-storage-and-shelving link present in nav but not in the sitemap and its rendered page silently serves the generic Storage parent content, not its own 'Garage Storage' listing - bad slug). EXCLUDED (brand-collection pages, not category/subcategory taxonomy nodes): all /category/brands/* pages (Dorma, Disney, Catherine Lansfield, William Morris, Character World, Paoletti, Minky, Furn, Just Sheepskin, Ulster Weavers, etc.). LOW confidence: curtain-tiebacks-and-holdbacks (ambiguous textile-trim/hardware boundary, not explicitly covered by textile.md). Storage vs Furniture and Kitchen&Dining vs Storage boundaries applied per storage.md rules 13/21/26/27 using the site's own explicit path placement as the deciding signal throughout.
